===== ppBuildPools =====

async function ppBuildPools(plan){
    await ppEnsureFrequency();
    const pools={};
    PLAN_GRADES.forEach(gradeId=>{
      const data=n3aData(gradeId);if(!data){pools[gradeId]=[];return}
      const selected=new Set(ppSelectedSubjects(plan,gradeId,data));
      const years=ppTrainingYears(data),yearSet=new Set(years);
      const maxYear=years.length?Math.max(...years):0;
      const items=[];
      (data.groups||[]).forEach(group=>{
        if(!selected.has(group.subject))return;
        const hits=(group.hits||[]).filter(hit=>yearSet.has(Number(hit.year)));
        if(!hits.length)return;
        const sortedHits=[...hits].sort((a,b)=>b.year-a.year||b.session-a.session||b.number-a.number);
        items.push({
          key:ppItemKey(gradeId,group.id),gradeId,groupId:group.id,subject:group.subject,
          question:group.question,normalized:group.normalized,count:hits.length,latest:sortedHits[0].year,
          hits:sortedHits,rep:sortedHits[0],years:[...new Set(hits.map(h=>Number(h.year)))].sort((a,b)=>a-b),maxYear
        }

===== ppGetDailyAssignment =====

async function ppGetDailyAssignment(plan,pools,progress,force){
    const today=ppDateKey(new Date()),daily=ppLoadDaily(),signature=ppPlanSignature(plan,pools);
    if(force||!daily[today]||daily[today].signature!==signature){
      const built=ppBuildTodayAssignment(plan,pools,progress,today);
      daily[today]={...built,signature};ppSaveDaily(daily);
    }

    const grade=q._planGrade,color=ppGradeColor(grade),markers=['㉮','㉯','㉰','㉱'];
    const isCorrect=showFeedback&&selected===correct;
